subject: speaker-after-camera: cause verified, patches 0330/0331 in gpu/build/i2c8cam-20261111
body:
CAUSE (verified in code + host repro, not a bus/electrical fault): the camera powers the CAM MTCMOS (SPM PWR_STATUS bit23) at its first session and keeps it on. The kernel's audio_i2c8.o/audio_hw.o are the 24 Oct CI archive members (never recompiled by build_p1_candidate.py; the stage .c files are older than them), and they still refuse while bit23 is on: audio_i2c8 stage 5 REFUSE(16) (phone: i2c=5/16 i2cpa=10006170, then stop's bus_clock_restore fails -> uncertain=1 sticky; user3-6) and bus_clock_prepare (phone user2: i2c=16/0 i2cpa=11d04104). 0284's stage-5 removal only ever went into the stale stage source. The FAN53870 bit-bang left the bus fine (pinmux/IES checks passed, FAN dumps ok). Host model reproduces both signatures exactly and passes with the fix.
PATCHES (dir gpu/build/i2c8cam-20261111, pass --patch-dir gpu/build/i2c8cam-20261111, append to --series after 0321):
 0330 (REQUIRED): stage audio_hw.c source record + build_p1_candidate.py now runs patch_audio_objs_0330.py when 0330 is in the series: 3 tbnz #23 -> nop in the CI members audio_i2c8.o/audio_hw.o (sha256/word/context checked; refuses a second application). Receipt key audio_objs_0330.
 0331 (recommended): nord2_cam.inc + audio_hw_native.inc (both in sweet_touch.o): camera takes the I2C8 lease per FAN transaction (<2 ms), pins back to SCL8/SDA8 each time, 9-clock bus clear if SDA stuck; audio lease waits up to 4 ms for owner 2. Compiles clean in sweet_touch.c (full series 0310,0311,0320,0321,0330,0331 on the q10in stage).
shim-0330.diff = same fix for shim/nord2-xnu (source of the CI objects), not applied. Next phone log: 'NORD2 CAM: FAN53870 ok: I2C8 pins 0x..11...' line; no 'NORD2 AUDIO ERROR ... i2c=5/16' or 'i2c=16/0'; NORD2 AUDIO AMP START seq=N after SENINF CAM domain on.
